stratifiers.breakpointPolicy: Pre-defined categories only. No data-derived binning, so STRAT-08 is satisfied by construction.

finalizedMetrics.phab_LWDeqVolM100: Owner decision of 2026-09-22 under D9: publishes as preliminary although 47% of the borrowed pool has no value, because EPA's 2018-19 wood-volume algorithm makes the 2013-14 values not comparable, and is marked for verification against field data before it carries weight in a decision.

determinism.seedPolicy: Every resampling diagnostic (CURVE-02/04/06, RED-06, STRAT-06) derives its seed from the run seed, which is a function of the ecoregion, the retained site ids, and the methodology version. Quantiles, correlations, Kruskal-Wallis and Benjamini-Hochberg are deterministic.
determinism.orderPolicy: Metrics in metric_config order; stratifier candidates and their levels in registry-declared order, never data order; redundancy pairs by descending absolute Spearman.

records.subject: bent_TOTLNTAX

computed.why: Every published biological criterion in the STAF assessment library is scored on a state-specific field index (Michigan Procedure 51, the Carolina IBI scores, the Wisconsin and Minnesota IBIs), none of which can be computed from NRSA data, so none measures the same quantity as this metric. Ohio EPA's ecoregional biocriteria, the nearest published criterion for this ecoregion, were checked on 2026-09-21 and are not usable either. They set thresholds on composite indices rather than on a single community metric such as this one, those indices are computed under Ohio's own field protocol and are not carried by the NRSA archive, and they are Ohio water quality standards while half this ecoregion's stations lie in Indiana.

records.subject: phab_LWDeqVolM100
records.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag under standing decision curve04-accept-with-flag (policy 1.2), expanded from this record's own evidence. For this curve: no decision flip (the build validates with or without the site); the largest drop-one shift is 55 percent of a seed parameter (0.18 IQR), driven by site INS9-0918. Drop-one quartile sensitivity is inherent to a reference pool of this size on a skewed distribution, the driver is a valid reference site, and removal without a data-quality reason is prohibited. The curve carries the mandatory-review cap until this decision is on the record.

items.subject: phab_LWDeqVolM100
items.question: One site moves this curve past the influence threshold. Keep the site, investigate it, or accept the curve with the flag?
items.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag under standing decision curve04-accept-with-flag (policy 1.2), expanded from this record's own evidence. For this curve: no decision flip (the build validates with or without the site); the largest drop-one shift is 55 percent of a seed parameter (0.18 IQR), driven by site INS9-0918. Drop-one quartile sensitivity is inherent to a reference pool of this size on a skewed distribution, the driver is a valid reference site, and removal without a data-quality reason is prohibited. The curve carries the mandatory-review cap until this decision is on the record.
